sniper-simulator.title: Sniper Simulator - Free Online Shooting Game
sniper-simulator.slogan: Experience the thrill of precision shooting
sniper-simulator.description: Sniper Simulator is a first-person shooting simulation game where you play as a sniper, mastering classic guns and engaging in sniper training. With added assembly gameplay, enjoy both shooting and assembling. Easy to operate, stunning visuals, and realistic sound effects provide an immersive experience.
